description: Identify which of the 10 supported ATS platforms powers a career URL, or probe a company slug live across Workday (55+ Fortune 500 boards), Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, Pinpoint, Personio, Teamtailor, and SmartRecruiters to find active job boards and compensation availability.

input.description: Company career URL (e.g. https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite, https://boards.greenhouse.io/figma) or company slug (e.g. nvidia, salesforce, ramp, zoox, figma).

probeLive.description: When true, verifies live board reachability and samples active role titles.

name: detect_company_ats_board
